summary: Online hackathon for apps, games, tools and circuits built with TapeOut on X Layer. Shortlisted teams attend an offline demo day.
eligibility: Individuals and teams aged 18+ (or local majority), or legal entities. Restricted Persons under X Layer terms excluded.
title: X Layer TapeOut Accelerate

prize.description: 100,000 USDT (about US$100,000): 1 x 20,000, 5 x 10,000, 5 x 6,000. Paid in stages after eligibility checks.

notes: Entry is via a Google Form; organizers call the deadline provisional.
